facts.text: Bishop's Lodge borders 1.7 million acres of national forest in the foothills of the Sangre de Cristo Mountains near Santa Fe.
facts.excerpt: nestled in the foothills of the Sangre de Cristo Mountains and bordering 1.7 million acres of national forest

facts.text: The hilltop chapel at the lodge was built in 1874 as a private retreat by Santa Fe's first Roman Catholic archbishop, Jean-Baptiste Lamy.
facts.excerpt: The chapel, which was built to be a private retreat in 1874 by the first Roman Catholic archbishop of Santa Fe, Jean-Baptiste Lamy

facts.text: The chapel later became the centerpiece of the original Bishop's Lodge, which dates to 1918.
facts.excerpt: later became the centerpiece of the original 1918 Bishop’s Lodge

facts.text: Guestrooms have private terraces, traditional kiva fireplaces and woven Navajo rugs.
facts.excerpt: Cozy sanctuaries that are accented by private terraces, traditional kiva fireplaces, and woven Navajo rugs.

facts.text: The Kiva Suites are mountaintop suites with an outdoor plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: our unique mountaintop Kiva Suites with an outdoor plunge pool

facts.text: The Bunkhouse is built from reclaimed barn wood and has a two-story stone fireplace.
SkyFire draws inspiration from ingredients and textures found in Mexico and cooks on a wood-fired grill.
facts.excerpt: SkyFire draws inspiration from the diverse, rich ingredients and textures found in Mexico

facts.text: Dishes for dogs, made with the author of The Art of Canine Cuisine, are served through In-Room Dining.
facts.excerpt: Dishes created in collaboration with Deborah Davis, author of The Art of Canine Cuisine.

facts.text: The resort has an outdoor pool and hot tub for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Bishop’s Lodge has an outdoor pool and hot tub available to hotel guests

facts.text: Stream Dance, Wellbeing by Auberge is the on-site spa, in a casita-style adobe building.
facts.excerpt: our spa treatments are conducted in a casita-style adobe building

facts.text: A complimentary shuttle runs to the Santa Fe downtown plaza on a first come, first served basis.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary shuttle service to the Santa Fe downtown plaza is available on a first come, first served basis.

facts.text: Guests may borrow a complimentary Mercedes-Benz test vehicle for up to four hours, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Guests may also borrow a complimentary Mercedes-Benz test vehicle for up to four hours to explore Santa Fe and the surrounding area, subject to availability.

facts.text: The lodge is about 20 minutes from Santa Fe Regional Airport and 75 minutes from Albuquerque International Sunport.
facts.excerpt: approximately 20 minutes from Santa Fe Regional Airport (SAF) and 75 minutes from Albuquerque International Sunport (ABQ)

facts.text: Hourly babysitting can be arranged through the Lodge Host, and cribs and highchairs are available on request.
facts.excerpt: cribs and highchairs available upon request. Hourly babysitting can also be arranged through the Lodge Host

facts.text: Guests can take a guided two-hour walking tour of Canyon Road, Santa Fe's art district.
facts.excerpt: an immersive two-hour walking tour of Canyon Road, the city’s premier art destination

facts.text: Restored paintings by Warren Rollins, who reportedly paid a hotel bill with them, are part of the lodge's history.
facts.excerpt: Rollins racked up a hotel bill at the Bishop’s Lodge that he couldn’t afford and paid the tab with these paintings
